tutorial.rationale: The first-success tutorial uses the default overlay factory and has no construction-identity choice.

guide.rationale: The production workflow does not install a custom overlay factory; the owning module documents this advanced input.

architecture.rationale: Excluding unstable function identity is a host reconciliation detail and changes no durable ownership boundary.

migration.rationale: The fix preserves the public signature and requires no Compose migration choice for default hosts.

redirect.rationale: No public symbol or documentation route moved.
